topic.question: 外形和导热方向，怎样透露固体的结构？
topic.description: 观察盐与松香、玻璃和云母上的石蜡熔化边界，并追踪胶带剥离石墨薄层。

zh: 晶体结构与各向异性实验

translations.外形和导热方向，怎样透露固体的结构？: How do shape and heat flow reveal a solid’s structure?
translations.观察盐与松香、玻璃和云母上的石蜡熔化边界，并追踪胶带剥离石墨薄层。: Compare salt and rosin, wax melting on glass and mica, and adhesive-tape exfoliation of graphite.
translations.盐晶体、热传导石蜡与胶带剥离三个固体实验: Three solid experiments: salt crystals, wax heat conduction and tape exfoliation
translations.规则外形是线索，内部周期排列才是晶体特征: Regular shape is a clue; periodic internal order defines a crystal
translations.同一熔点勾出热传播的方向差别: A common melting threshold reveals directional heat spreading
translations.单层厚度约0.335纳米，图中尺度已放大: Nominal layer spacing: about 0.335 nm; greatly enlarged here
translations.示意追踪选中的薄片，实际每次剥离并非等分: An idealized selected flake; real peeling does not divide it equally
translations.晶体形状及原子排列为结构示意，非显微照片。: Crystal shapes and atomic arrangements are structural diagrams, not microscopy.
translations.热图由二维连续点热源的热扩散核积分得到，以50摄氏度等温线代表石蜡熔化边界；热扩: The thermal map integrates a continuous 2D point-source diffusion kernel; its 50 °C contour represents wax melting. Diffusivities are illustrative, not measured mica constants. Edge losses and latent heat are omitted. Shapes and atomic arrangements are diagrams, not microscopy. Tape follows an idealized equally divided flake; real work requires selection, transfer and monolayer identification.
translations.盐粒常有平直晶面，松香碎片外形不规则。: Salt grains show crystal faces; rosin fragments are irregular.
translations.晶体内部有周期排列；示意粒子不是显微镜可见的原子。: Crystalline order is periodic; these particles are schematic.
translations.用熔化边界显出热传播: Reveal heat flow with melting wax
translations.同样从一点加热，玻璃与云母出现不同的熔化区域。: Point heating produces different melting regions on glass and mica.
translations.圆形对应面内各向同性，椭圆反映面内各向异性。: A circle indicates in-plane isotropy; an ellipse reveals anisotropy.
translations.层间分离，可以保留片层内部的碳原子网络。: Separating layers can preserve each sheet’s carbon network.
translations.单层石墨烯保留二维蜂窝排列。: A graphene monolayer retains a two-dimensional honeycomb network.

cues.title: 比较食盐与松香
cues.caption: 盐粒常有平直晶面，松香碎片外形不规则。
cues.captionEn: Salt grains show crystal faces; rosin fragments are irregular.
cues.zh: 先观察食盐和松香。食盐颗粒常能看出平直的晶面和较规则的形状，松香碎片则没有固定的几何外形。外形给出了线索，但破碎的晶体也可能显得不规则。
cues.en: Compare salt with rosin. Salt grains often reveal flat faces and regular shapes, while rosin fragments lack a fixed geometric form. Shape is a clue, though a broken crystal can also look irregular.

cues.title: 把结构与外形区分
cues.caption: 晶体内部有周期排列；示意粒子不是显微镜可见的原子。
cues.captionEn: Crystalline order is periodic; these particles are schematic.
cues.zh: 下方用结构示意补充外形观察：晶体内部存在周期排列，非晶体缺少这种长程周期性。普通光学显微镜看不到图示的单个原子，不能把结构示意误作直接照片。
cues.en: The structural inset adds something external appearance cannot show: crystals have periodic internal order, while amorphous solids lack long-range periodicity. An ordinary optical microscope does not resolve these individual atoms; the inset is a diagram, not a direct photograph.

cues.title: 用熔化边界显出热传播
cues.titleEn: Reveal heat flow with melting wax
cues.caption: 同样从一点加热，玻璃与云母出现不同的熔化区域。
cues.captionEn: Point heating produces different melting regions on glass and mica.
cues.zh: 在玻璃和云母薄片上涂一层薄石蜡，用热烙铁从背面接触一点。颜色变化表示达到同一个熔化温度。随加热继续，玻璃近似形成圆形，云母的边界沿某一方向伸得更远。
cues.en: Coat glass and mica sheets with thin wax and heat one point from the back. The changing region reaches the same melting temperature. Glass produces a nearly circular boundary, while mica spreads farther along one direction.

cues.title: 同一温度，不同方向
cues.caption: 圆形对应面内各向同性，椭圆反映面内各向异性。
cues.captionEn: A circle indicates in-plane isotropy; an ellipse reveals anisotropy.
cues.zh: 停在同一加热时刻比较边界。圆形表示这个平面内各方向的热传播相近，椭圆则表明不同方向不同。并非所有晶体的每一种性质都各向异性，实验要说明测量的性质和方向。
cues.en: Pause at one heating time. A circle means similar thermal spreading in all directions within the sheet; an ellipse reveals a directional difference. Not every property of every crystal is anisotropic: specify both the property and directions being tested.

cues.title: 胶带带走更薄的片层
cues.caption: 层间分离，可以保留片层内部的碳原子网络。
cues.captionEn: Separating layers can preserve each sheet’s carbon network.
cues.zh: 胶带粘住石墨表面，再揭起时会带走薄片。重复处理并选择较薄的区域，可以得到越来越少的层数。图中追踪一个理想化等分薄片，真实剥离并不保证每次减半，也不保证每片都成为单层。
cues.en: Adhesive tape lifts thin flakes from graphite. Repeated peeling and selection can leave progressively fewer layers. We track an idealized equally split flake; actual peeling neither halves every flake nor guarantees that each becomes a monolayer.

cues.title: 留下单层蜂窝网络
cues.caption: 单层石墨烯保留二维蜂窝排列。
cues.captionEn: A graphene monolayer retains a two-dimensional honeycomb network.
cues.zh: 放大最终选中的单层，碳原子连成蜂窝状网络。这里的层间距尺度约为零点三三五纳米，画面为可观察而大幅放大。实际研究还要转移到合适衬底，并用独立方法鉴定是否真的是单层。
cues.en: Enlarge the selected monolayer: carbon atoms form a honeycomb network. The associated graphite layer-spacing scale is about zero point three three five nanometres, enormously enlarged here. Real experiments transfer flakes to a suitable substrate and independently identify monolayers.
